scope_note: All three targets built in the small panel modules; synapse_panel.py NEVER touched (peer-claimed by W5-ROPE + W5-LIFE). Bus claim disjoint from all open peer claims. Qt claims proven under hython Houdini 22.0.400 (real PySide6, Python 3.13.10, offscreen), not headless-skipped.

acceptance.predicate: font floor == host default at runtime and switcher only scales up from it (no state below floor reachable)
acceptance.evidence: MATH delivered and proven: designsystem/tokens.py host_floored_steps + next_font_scale guarantee no reachable scale < host_scale for all host scales (large>1, small<1, exact-ladder-value, non-positive) - tests/panel/test_font_floor.py, 8 pass (pure, runs headless AND under hython). The guarantee derives the floor from the host at runtime (host_scale param); no hardcoded font pt introduced. LIVE acceptance NOT met by this leg: the running switcher still reaches below-floor states at TWO sites in the peer-claimed, off-limits synapse_panel.py - _cycle_font_scale (:2087, raw-ladder wrap to 1.0) AND the 'Larger text' menu action (:1948, unconditional _set_scale(1.15), below floor on any host >~13.8px UI font). Rewiring is a for_ruling handoff (F1/R1) with the exact two-call-site one-liners in W5-PANEL_notes.md, verified to keep tests/panel/test_font_scale.py::test_aa_cycle_steps_above_a_host_base_scale green. Marked UNKNOWN, not pass: PASS would launder an unshipped fix; not fail: nothing is broken, the fix is blocked on a peer-claimed surface.

acceptance.predicate: chat leading increased by 0.75pt over prior value, asserted against the widget's effective line spacing
acceptance.evidence: chat_display.py::_apply_leading merges an absolute QTextBlockFormat LineDistanceHeight (chat_leading_px() = 0.75*96/72 = 1.0px/line) onto every inserted block on the Qt main thread (user + synapse sync/async + system paths), O(inserted range). Proven EFFECTIVE, not merely set: tests/panel/test_chat_leading.py 5 pass / 0 skip under hython 22.0.400 - a 12-line block's document height grows 176->188 (delta = 1.0px x 12 lines) and shrinks back when the format is stripped; the mechanism is verified NON-inert, unlike the CSS line-height / ProportionalHeight predecessors documented at message_formatter.py:43. Crucible: verdict holds.

acceptance.predicate: Token tab spend traces to a real usage source for the selected model; unmeasurable states render UNKNOWN
acceptance.evidence: New pure usage_sink.py folds provider.last_usage across the whole worker tool loop (claude_worker._conversation_loop: begin_task at loop top, add() after each stream() before the abort check) so per-task spend defeats the per-stream reset. face_token._refresh_usage (via the already-wired tab-open refresh_from_probe, run AFTER the probe so the real model wins) lands CACHE prefix<-cache_read, CACHE last-turn<-cache_creation, ENGINE model<-the selected model that spent. Every SPEND number traces to provider.last_usage - an Anthropic API receipt (anthropic_provider.py:278, publishes even on abort), pinned by tests/test_provider_cache_and_usage.py (12 pass). Honesty intact: non-Anthropic engines inherit last_usage=None (base.py:42) -> spend UNKNOWN not 0; bool never counted; a real measured 0 kept while never-measured stays None -> UNKNOWN (set_row). tests/test_token_tab_usage.py: 10 pure pass headless, 14 pass / 0 skip under hython (the 4 Qt worker/FaceToken tests genuinely run). No synapse_panel.py edit; sink lock-guarded (worker writes background thread, main-thread reads on tab-open). Crucible: verdict holds_with_caveats (peripheral wording caveats in F2/F3, core claim holds).

findings.claim: There are TWO below-floor entry points in the off-limits synapse_panel.py, not one: _cycle_font_scale (:2087) AND the 'Larger text' menu action (:1948, unconditional _set_scale(1.15)). Fixing only the switcher leaves 'Larger text' reachable below the floor.
findings.disposition: Addressed in for_ruling R1 (both call sites enumerated with exact wiring). 'Default text' (:1949 -> _set_scale(_chrome_scale)) is already floor-correct.

findings.claim: Not every row on the tab is a usage receipt or UNKNOWN: the THIS-TURN composition still shows system-prompt / tool-surface as pre-existing char-derived estimates (~6% low, footnote-disclosed via measure_static), and 'cost' shows a probe-fed value (honest measured 0.0 for a free local model, UNKNOWN for a metered one). Neither is faked from the usage receipt; both are pre-existing and untouched by this leg's wiring.
findings.disposition: Out of scope, pre-existing, honestly disclosed. The wired SPEND numbers (cache, model) are the receipts; the leg does not claim the whole tab is receipts-or-UNKNOWN.

findings.claim: ENGINE 'model' now comes from the last task's real spend (sink) while 'runs'/'cost'/'probed' come from the first available probe. Under cross-engine use these can name different engines; the common single-engine case agrees. Cache rows + model row stay mutually consistent (one snapshot).
findings.disposition: Accepted minor caveat - showing the model that actually spent is correct for 'the selected model'; not worth fragile cross-engine reconciliation. Documented in W5-PANEL_notes.md.

findings.claim: The applied leading is 1px/line at Qt's 96-DPI logical default; its perceptibility on high-DPI/retina Houdini seats was not measured.
findings.disposition: Honest per the +0.75pt request; see spawn S1 (probe).

findings.claim: USAGE_SINK is a process-wide singleton (lock-guarded); correct for the panel's one-conversation-at-a-time model. A mid-task tab-open reads a partial-but-honest running total.
findings.disposition: Accepted; noted for any future multi-worker path.

findings.claim: The initial LineDistanceHeight-enum comment mis-attributed the fallback path to PySide2; the crucible live-probe showed this PySide6 build (H22.0.400) shadows the nested enum with a Property and hits the fallback. Comment corrected post-review; functionally always yielded int 4.
findings.disposition: Fixed in the product commit d657dd45.
